personas.segment: newcomer, low literacy, visible text only
goals: Understand what AZOA offers and where I sign in
Recover from an operator page when signed out

personas.segment: developer using only keyboard and accessibility tree
goals: Find my wallets and account settings

personas.segment: returning developer on a slow network using 200 percent zoom
goals: Navigate account and verification screens without losing context

personas.segment: interrupted node operator inspecting state only
goals: Find audit history and understand permission or session recovery
Find my account and integration settings

personas.segment: capability probe, excluded from UX metrics
goals: Inspect CLI help and unauthenticated fail-closed node-admin behavior without a root key

lanes.name: mobile-comprehension
lanes.journey: Explore public pages and sign-in choices using visible text only at 390 pixels. No source or API. Record confusion and stop after two failed attempts.

lanes.name: keyboard-account
lanes.journey: Use keyboard only and accessibility snapshots to find wallets, settings and identity status; record focus or labeling barriers. No pointer clicks or source.

lanes.name: zoom-slow-account
lanes.journey: At 200 percent zoom on a slow network, inspect overview, wallet and verification status, then settings; no value, provider or notification writes.

lanes.name: operator-readiness
lanes.journey: Inspect read-only node overview, audit, tenants and provider information. Explain permission/expired-session states and recover only through visible UI. No administrative writes.

lanes.name: gold-goals
lanes.journey: Run all declared gold tasks through runGold, each in its own trace. Do not inspect predicate implementation or application source. API workarounds are failure evidence.

lanes.name: cli-auth-probe
lanes.journey: Inspect CLI help and existing node-admin authorization contracts; perform only anonymous or deliberately invalid-key requests to guarded local endpoints. Never read, create or use owner root keys. Record expected statuses against code; do not weaken assertions or treat this as UI gold success.
